`tdx_quote_v4.dat` is the `tdx_prod_quote_SPR_E4.dat` test fixture from
`github.com/google/go-tdx-guest` v0.3.1. It is used only to exercise quote
parsing and TrustedRouter's local policy checks; tests replace the report data
and measurements and stub network collateral verification. The upstream
project is licensed under Apache-2.0.
